Youngchun_Touch2: Yes, yes. Right there, right there.
Youngchun_DutchRubEnd2: Ugh! Why are you doing this?
Item_NPCSkin_Desc_Youngchun_Skin1: Youngchun has wrapped herself in a bear hide of exactly the right size, found who knows where. Her punches remain as soft as drifting dandelion seeds.
Youngchun_Touch2_Skin1: This makes me want to sprawl out and sleep.
Youngchun_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: Roar! I am going to catch you!
Youngchun_Line1_Skin1: It is so warm that I am getting sleepy.
Youngchun_Line2_Skin1: Wearing this makes it comfortable even to lie right on the floor.
Item_NPCSkin_Desc_Youngchun_Skin2: Youngchun has dressed herself to the fullest. They say those who live together grow alike, and the person she brings to mind does not seem to be a coincidence.
Youngchun_Touch1_Skin2: Does this form not frighten you?
Youngchun_Touch2_Skin2: Yes, that is right. Pay attention to my presence.
Youngchun_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: Hey! You are crushing my flower crown!
Youngchun_Line1_Skin2: Sometimes it is fun to imitate someone else.
Youngchun_Line2_Skin2: Yellow and green. Would you be angry if I called it forsythia coloring?
Youngchun_Line3_Skin2: Watching the Master work is always entertaining.
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Youngchun_Skin3: Youngchun imitates the corrupted Youngchun who emerged from a dimensional portal. She constantly pretends to be a drill instructor and works to create a frightening atmosphere, but everything she does merely looks adorable.
Youngchun_Touch1_Skin3: This instructor is disappointed in you, Master!
Youngchun_Touch2_Skin3: Is it time for a short break?
Youngchun_DutchRubEnd2_Skin3: Do you want to be called to formation today?
Youngchun_Line1_Skin3: Take the Youngchun Punch, now one hundred times stronger!
Youngchun_Line2_Skin3: Master, present me with heaps of delicious macarons at once!
Youngchun_Line3_Skin3: Nobody will notice if I doze off like this, right?
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Youngchun_Skin4: Youngchun wears an outfit styled after golden, perfectly fried shrimp tempura. The thick, fluffy clothes almost seem to release a savory fried aroma.
Youngchun_Touch1_Skin4: Stop! My cheeks will get soggy!
Youngchun_Touch2_Skin4: Pet me carefully so you do not get oil on yourself.
Youngchun_DutchRubEnd2_Skin4: Hey! You flattened my crispy coating!
Youngchun_Line1_Skin4: Hehe, I look crispy outside and tender inside, right?
Youngchun_Line3_Skin4: Master, staying near me will make you hungry.
Youngchun_Birthday: Happy birthday, Master! You are taking good care of the Order, right?
Youngchun_Line1: Forsythia, forsythia, pick one and hold it in your mouth.
Youngchun_Line2: Let me see what is really on your mind.
Youngchun_Line3: My head starts to hurt when I resist the Master.
Youngchun_StartJourney1: Is it an acorn? Is it? Is it an acorn?
Youngchun_StartJourney2: Now then, shall I read what is really on your mind?
Youngchun_StartJourney3: I can feel a mysterious power.
Youngchun_Strength: I'm feeling some sort of mystical power!
NPC_Desc_Youngchun: A forsythia-like being who spends her time napping and chatting while staying near the Master. Sometimes she's helpful and sometimes she's not, but no matter what she does, she always feels trivial. She's cute.
NPC_Line1_Youngchun: Hey! I told you not to write about me in that!
